messages:
Maria (sales): hey team, acme-eats POC just hit a bad window during a demo — they reported lots of 5xx + some 429s. Repro: ramp to ~400rps for 90s then steady. Can we triage? @Alex (oncall) @Priya (support)
Alex (oncall): seen the alert. Gateway logs show repeated 'capacity_throttle' and autoscaler went from 2 -> 8 but new workers weren't ready fast enough. Queue depth spiked.
Priya (support): customer said they saw 503s for ~45s and then partial success. They pasted this curl output: ```curl -i https://api.redwood.test/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACT'``` response: ```HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
x-rw-throttle: capacity_throttle
retry-after: 0.8
{ "error": "server overloaded" }```
Jordan (solutions): they're asking if Dedicated/reserved capacity would avoid this and what pricing looks like if we need a short spike buffer for demos. Also asking about fallback policies.
Alex (oncall): Dedicated would reduce noisy-neighbor issues and give fixed headroom. For short demo spikes we usually recommend: 1) enable burst pool (if eligible) 2) configure fallback routing to a smaller model variant 3) tune client retry policy with jitter and backoff.
Priya (support): logs snippet from gateway (sanitized): ```[2026-05-03T14:11:02Z] request_id=abc123 route=/v1/generate model=rwd-large-v1 latency_ms=1200 status=503 reason=capacity_throttle queue_ms=4500
[2026-05-03T14:11:05Z] autoscaler: desired=8 current=2 provisioning=6 avg_pod_ready_sec=18
[2026-05-03T14:11:07Z] cache: prefix_hits=12 miss=488```
Alex (oncall): key takeaways: a) provisioning lag ~18s — we saw pods start but not serve fast enough b) queue_ms spiked causing upstream gateway to drop to 503s instead of buffering c) burst pool depleted during the continuous ramp.
Maria (sales): customer wants a checklist we can run before demos to avoid this — can we give a short runnable checklist?
Alex (oncall): checklist draft: 
- pre-warm: run a 60s warmup at ~25-30% expected demo RPS 10-15 minutes prior
- client retry: exponential backoff starting at 200ms, max 1.5s with jitter, cap retries to 3
- fallback model: route to rwd-medium-v1 at 50% fewer tokens if timeout or 503 seen
- enable burstpool for demo windows (contact sales to confirm eligibility)
- short-term: request manual capacity boost from eng (we can reserve warm workers for a few hours)
Jordan (solutions): I'll add pricing bullets: burstpool use billed on consumption; Dedicated short-term swaps require an SRE ticket (we usually do a temporary warm-up commit).
Priya (support): quick remediation steps we ran now: increased max inflight per worker, applied a 15s init-delay to autoscaler to reduce thundering, enabled fallback-to-medium. After that we saw errors drop from 20/min -> ~1/min.
Alex (oncall): long-term follow-ups: look at model quantization/trim for demo-friendly profiles, add adaptive prefetching for hot prompts, and improve autoscaler warmup heuristics. Filed ENG-PLATFORM ticket if needed.
Maria (sales): customer also asked about security questionnaires — flagged separately to SE and legal. Not blocking but they want SAML/KMS details.
Jordan (solutions): pro tip for demos: if you expect sustained high concurrency, book a Dedicated demo slot (we can pre-provision). I'll follow up with an estimate by EOD.
Priya (support): sharing dashboard links: https://console.redwood.test/customers/acme-eats/poc/metrics — look at queue_ms and burstpool_remaining.
Alex (oncall): for the immediate POC we recommended a client-side quick patch: add 300ms base jittered backoff and fallback header: `x-rw-fallback: rwd-medium-v1`. Send me the curl test and I'll run a repro in staging.
Maria (sales): thanks all — I pinged the customer with the checklist and short-term mitigation. Will loop back once Jordan has the pricing. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: autoscale event: created 6 new workers for cluster-poc-034 (id: cl-poc-034)
Alex (oncall): follow-up note — observed that when queue_ms > 3s the gateway prefers 503 over adding more latency to clients; that threshold can be tuned per-customer if they accept higher tail latency.
Priya (support): closing loop: errors dropped during final 10m of test. Customer will run two more demos next week; Jordan to confirm Dedicated/demo-hour pricing.
Maria (sales): great. tagging resolution: mitigated, action items assigned.
